catalog.noControls: This model chooses the output dimensions and format. Each product generates one image.
catalog.invalidValue: This value is not allowed for this model.

openai.sizeHelp: Both edges must be divisible by 16; max edge 3840; ratio at most 3:1; 655,360–8,294,400 pixels.
openai.sizeError: This size does not meet {model} constraints.
openai.outputSizeHelp: Dimensions of the generated picture. Choose square, landscape, or portrait; the source and mask dimensions stay unchanged.
openai.qualityHelp25: Rendering effort, separate from resolution. Higher settings can take longer and cost more; they do not guarantee a better image.
openai.qualityHelp2: Rendering effort, separate from resolution. Higher settings can take longer and use more output tokens.
openai.qualityHelpLegacy: Higher quality can take longer and use more output tokens.
openai.backgroundHelp: Auto lets the model decide; Opaque fills the background; Transparent preserves empty areas using PNG or WebP.
openai.backgroundHelpOpaqueOnly: Auto lets the model decide; Opaque fills the background. Transparent output is not available for this model in this app.
openai.outputFormatHelp: PNG or WebP can preserve transparency when enabled. JPEG cannot. PNG has no compression control.
openai.outputFormatHelpOpaqueOnly: Choose the saved file type. PNG alone does not create transparency. PNG has no compression control.
openai.outputCompressionHelp: Optional compression value, 0–100, for JPEG or WebP. It affects file size and image detail; blank uses the model default.
openai.moderationHelp: All prompts and generated images remain filtered.
openai.numberOfImagesHelp: Creates 1–10 outputs for each generation job.
openai.endUserHelp: Helps OpenAI monitor abuse. Do not enter a name, email address, or other personal data.
openai.note25: Resolutions above 2560x1440 are experimental. Each selected product image gets its own generation job.
openai.note2: Input fidelity is always high. Seed, style, transparent background, and a separate aspect-ratio field are intentionally unavailable.
openai.noteLegacy: Each selected product image gets its own generation job.

gemini.legacyNotice: Output is fixed to the model's 1024-class resolution. Thinking and grounding controls are unavailable.
gemini.imageSizeHelp31: 512 is fastest; 2K/4K increase latency and cost.
gemini.imageSizeHelpFixed: Fixed by the model; other sizes are unavailable.
gemini.imageSizeHelpPro: Higher resolutions increase latency and cost.
gemini.thinkingHelp31: High can improve complex composition and instruction following.
gemini.thinkingHelpLite: High trades additional latency for more planning.
gemini.groundingHelp31: Image search cannot use real-world images of people.
gemini.groundingHelpPro: This model supports web grounding, not image-search grounding.
gemini.groundingUnavailableLite: Grounding is unavailable on Flash Lite.
gemini.includeThoughtsHelp: Returns thought summaries when the provider supplies them.
gemini.includeThoughtsHelpPro: Thinking is always enabled; only its returned summary is configurable.
gemini.aspectRatioHelp: The output shape: 1:1 is square, 16:9 is wide, and 9:16 is tall. Default follows the first reference’s ratio or uses 1:1 without a reference.
gemini.includeText: Return model text with the image
gemini.includeTextHelp: Stores any explanatory text returned alongside the generated image.
gemini.samplingHelp: Optional advanced controls. Start with blank values to use the provider defaults; tuning sampling can make instruction following less reliable.
gemini.temperatureHelp: Randomness in the model’s choices. Higher values can vary the result; this does not control resolution or image quality.
gemini.topPHelp: Limits choices by their combined probability. Leave blank unless you are deliberately comparing sampling settings.
gemini.topKHelp: Limits the number of likely choices considered at each step, when supported by the provider.
gemini.seedHelp: Optional starting value for randomness. The same seed does not guarantee the same picture or preserve a person’s identity.
gemini.maxOutputTokensHelp: Minimum {min} for this image tier; maximum {max}. Leave blank for the provider default.
gemini.safetyHelp: Applied independently to each supported harm category.

guidance.pipelineMask: Connect the source to the image input and the prepared mask to Mask, or choose the mask in this step’s settings.
guidance.peopleMask: Masks guide a selected region of an existing picture. The People generator uses identity references without a separate mask. Use Edit or a pipeline when you need a masked edit.
guidance.peopleOutput: Variations creates separate jobs; the model’s image count adds outputs to each job. The People factory accepts at most 4 pictures per request. Final prices appear after they are confirmed.

textTemplates.catalogDescription: {name} generates product imagery from text and uploaded pictures.
textTemplates.guidanceReferences: The source is the picture being edited. Extra references guide identity, clothing, style, or composition. This model accepts up to {count} pictures in one job, counting the source and references together.
textTemplates.guidanceOutputOne: 1 output image per job with these settings. Each batch input runs independently; shared references repeat for every input. A request can produce at most 50 images. Final prices appear after they are confirmed.
textTemplates.guidanceOutputMany: {count} output images per job with these settings. Each batch input runs independently; shared references repeat for every input. A request can produce at most 50 images. Final prices appear after they are confirmed.

text.4k_output_may_still_11988528: 4K output may still be preview-level even though the model ID is GA.
text.a_legacy_1024_class_bb672a91: A legacy 1024-class image editor retained for older work. Describe edits in text; thinking and search controls are unavailable.
text.a_legacy_image_editor_48a9125e: A legacy image editor with fixed sizes, optional edit masks, and transparent output. Keep it for comparing or repeating earlier work.
text.a_low_cost_multimodal_bfc59a4e: A low-cost multimodal model for expanding short prompts while checking optional reference pictures.
text.a_smaller_legacy_image_c21b4d2a: A smaller legacy image editor with fixed sizes, optional edit masks, and transparent output. Inspect fine product details before using a result.
text.adds_the_model_s_3b50dfd5: Adds the model’s visible AI-generated watermark to the output when enabled.
text.all_generated_images_include_68cd737e: All generated images include SynthID and C2PA metadata.
text.an_optional_starting_value_7e10d12d: An optional starting value for random generation. Keep other settings and inputs the same for comparisons; a seed does not guarantee identical images.
text.best_general_purpose_gemini_f10e29ee: Best general-purpose Gemini image model; supports 512–4K, thinking, and web/image grounding.
text.combine_product_or_person_0eb76c7f: Combine product or person references. Choose the resolution and output format separately from your prompt.
text.combine_product_person_and_f088227e: Combine product, person, and style references in one image. Explain which picture supplies each detail and what should remain unchanged.
text.combine_several_references_for_8618e5be: Combine several references for a product edit. Specify which details come from each picture.
text.combine_several_references_for_92ad5f2b: Combine several references for a product edit. Name the subject, lighting, and role of each reference.
text.create_an_image_from_af0a4ad8: Create an image from several product or person references. Describe each picture’s role and choose the output resolution.
text.create_or_edit_product_acb06543: Create or edit product images with a fixed output size, optional edit mask, and optional transparent background.
text.describe_a_composition_using_643b4e21: Describe a composition using the uploaded pictures. This model chooses its output dimensions and format; there are no size controls.
text.describe_complex_compositions_and_006df4: Describe complex compositions and text precisely. Assign a clear role to each product, person, or style reference.
text.dimensions_above_roughly_2k_cbdc15d4: Dimensions above roughly 2K should be treated as experimental through Gateway until verified.
text.edit_or_compose_from_4cdbfc68: Edit or compose from a small set of references. Name the change and the product features to preserve.
text.edit_or_compose_from_8508ff89: Edit or compose from a few references. Choose Aspect ratio, Resolution, and Images per product separately from your prompt.
text.edit_or_compose_from_edfd2699: Edit or compose from a few references. Choose the framing with Aspect ratio and use Images per product for variations.
text.edits_are_described_in_0629e226: Edits are described in the prompt. A separate mask is not supported.
text.faster_cpu_cutouts_for_ed20d9c7: Faster CPU cutouts for product photos and clothing.
text.fill_mask_white_replaces_1affbc42: Fill mask · white replaces, black keeps
text.for_a_new_background_3769515d: For a new background, paint the background white and the product black in a separate image editor, then upload that PNG as the mask.
text.for_a_transparent_image_cdcacde6: For a transparent image, choose Background → Transparent and use PNG or WebP. A white backdrop or a drawn checkerboard does not create transparency.
text.google_image_search_grounding_905683fd: Google Image Search grounding cannot use real-world images of people.
text.google_search_grounding_is_9e60e100: Google Search grounding is not supported.
text.higher_quality_settings_can_6c856d99: Higher quality settings can increase generation time and cost.
text.how_strongly_the_uploaded_88434af4: How strongly the uploaded picture guides the new composition, from 0 to 1. It does not select an area to edit.
text.input_fidelity_is_always_d9409eab: Input fidelity is always high and cannot be changed.
text.keep_the_product_s_52a7f8fa: Keep the product’s shape, colour, fabric, and labels. Change only the background to a warm studio setting with soft light.
text.legacy_1024_class_gemini_6eb6028d: Legacy 1024-class Gemini model retained for comparison and reproducibility.
text.lowest_latency_low_cost_589b91c6: Lowest-latency, low-cost Gemini image generation and editing; fixed to 1K output.
text.make_a_targeted_edit_43407da3: Make a targeted edit to one source picture. Describe exactly what to change and what to keep.
text.more_detail_for_complex_879d543a: More detail for complex edges; slower and uses more memory.
text.none_gives_a_direct_eb9a2975: None gives a direct rewrite. Higher levels spend more time reasoning about your instructions and may cost more. Temperature is available only with None. Reasoning shares the output-token cap.
text.none_preserves_the_original_ce25c2ab: None preserves the original fast rewrite. Low, Medium and High use fixed thinking budgets of 512, 1024 and 2048 tokens. Thinking shares the output cap and is billed.
text.openai_image_generation_and_6d451bc0: OpenAI image generation and editing from text and pictures, optimized for fast everyday work.
text.openai_image_generation_and_6faf7372: OpenAI image generation and editing with fixed sizes, transparency, masks, and up to ten outputs.
text.openai_image_generation_and_ae653d74: OpenAI image generation and editing with custom dimensions, masks, and up to ten outputs.
text.openai_image_generation_from_fc249ea6: OpenAI image generation from text and pictures, focused on precise product edits.
text.openai_s_efficient_text_7276758f: OpenAI’s efficient text-and-image reasoning model for focused prompt improvements.
text.output_dimensions_are_chosen_4f112cf5: Output dimensions are chosen by the model. One output per product.
text.premium_gemini_model_for_2c756645: Premium Gemini model for complex professional assets, text rendering, and high-fidelity edits.
text.quality_is_best_with_417fd8f6: Quality is best with at most three reference images; this is guidance, not a documented API hard limit.
text.reference_fidelity_guidance_up_d559d338: Reference fidelity guidance: up to 6 object, 5 character, and 3 style references (14 total).
text.reference_fidelity_guidance_up_f5b3e724: Reference fidelity guidance: up to 10 object references and 4 character references (14 total).
text.reference_inputs_are_image_5b67988d: Reference inputs are image files only; this product does not accept PDF, video, audio, or other media.
text.reference_inputs_are_image_7f8f452f: Reference inputs are image files only; use PNG, JPEG, or WebP.
text.reference_inputs_are_image_ca4a9a65: Reference inputs are image files only; use PNG or JPEG.
text.replace_part_of_one_5562ec17: Replace part of one picture using a required black-and-white fill mask and a prompt for the replacement.
text.replace_the_white_masked_e651018b: Replace the white masked background with a warm studio wall. Keep the product in the black area.
text.requires_a_source_and_daa17c57: Requires a source and a same-size PNG mask. White areas are replaced; black areas are preserved.
text.scheduled_to_retire_october_4434d4e0: Scheduled to retire October 2, 2026. Prefer Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite or Flash.
text.start_with_auto_quality_d1171449: Start with Auto quality. Increase it when a specific detail needs improvement; a higher setting can take longer and does not guarantee a better result.
text.supports_up_to_14_1b69a4fb: Supports up to 14 object references; this model does not define separate character or style-reference buckets.
text.the_existing_pipeline_text_aafc3dcf: The existing pipeline text model, retained for saved pipelines and exact replay.
text.the_file_type_saved_fa346438: The file type saved for the result. PNG output alone does not create a transparent background.
text.the_generated_picture_s_293d626a: The generated picture’s width and height. This does not resize your source or mask.
text.the_mask_guides_where_203e11a7: The mask guides where to make an edit on the first source image. Fully transparent areas mark what to change; opaque areas mark what to keep. The model can still change details outside the mask.
text.the_mask_marks_the_cf5618e5: The mask marks the part of the source to replace. White selects the replacement area; black keeps the original area. This model requires a mask.
text.the_output_resolution_tier_135e7563: The output resolution tier. Larger pictures can take longer; the result’s actual dimensions appear in its details.
text.the_picture_supplies_visual_b4139b30: The picture supplies visual guidance, rather than an exact area to edit. This model accepts one picture per job.
text.the_shape_of_the_ab64e7d5: The shape of the output: 1:1 is square, 16:9 is wide, and 9:16 is tall. This is separate from resolution.
text.thinking_controls_and_search_ea41ff46: Thinking controls and Search grounding are not supported.
text.thinking_controls_planning_before_7f38d9: Thinking controls planning before the image. Grounding adds search information; it does not select your uploaded references.
text.thinking_is_always_enabled_953c4673: Thinking is always enabled and its level is not configurable for this image model.
text.thinking_is_always_enabled_b53e19d3: Thinking is always enabled. Include thoughts stores a returned summary; it does not turn thinking on or off.
text.thinking_is_always_enabled_e29dd6c0: Thinking is always enabled. Low suits simple rewrites; High or Max spends more time on detailed constraints. Reasoning tokens count toward the output cap and the confirmed bill.
text.thinking_is_configurable_but_45d06e79: Thinking is configurable, but search grounding and other output-size tiers are unavailable for this model.
text.this_model_is_less_511559a4: This model is less suited to complex multi-reference or multi-turn work.
text.to_change_a_background_546a0677: To change a background, make the background transparent in the mask and keep the product opaque. Describe the replacement background in your prompt.
text.transparent_backgrounds_require_png_b447: Transparent backgrounds require PNG or WebP output.
text.transparent_backgrounds_seed_style_487bb: Transparent backgrounds, seed, style, and a separate aspect-ratio option are not supported.
text.transparent_output_is_not_0b68fa0f: Transparent output is not available through this model in this app. PNG alone does not make a cutout. Use Remove backgrounds for a transparent product image.
text.transparent_output_is_selected_8c1dc37d: Transparent output is selected. PNG or WebP preserves the alpha channel; JPEG cannot. An input edit mask and an output transparent background are separate choices.
text.upload_a_black_and_62d9cfc7: Upload a black-and-white PNG with the same width and height as the source. Use the same dimensions for every input in a batch.
text.use_a_png_with_bf8a142e: Use a PNG with an alpha channel, prepared in a separate image editor. In this app, the source must also be PNG and match the mask’s width and height. Every input in a batch must match.
text.use_for_detailed_product_021cac44: Use for detailed product edits. Describe the change and explicitly name the product details that must stay the same.
text.use_for_everyday_image_2440bff1: Use for everyday image edits and new compositions when speed matters. Describe the subject, setting, lighting, and details to preserve.
text.use_for_product_edits_76411428: Use for product edits with custom output dimensions. Its mask guides local edits; this app currently exposes only Auto and Opaque backgrounds.
text.use_for_straightforward_edits_59300bca: Use for straightforward edits at the fixed 1K size. Start with a small set of clear references for simpler compositions.
text.use_one_picture_as_19b4d912: Use one picture as visual inspiration for a new composition. Reference influence controls how strongly it guides the result.
text.use_one_picture_as_48b7e85a: Use one picture as visual inspiration for a new composition. For a targeted edit of the original, choose FLUX Kontext or FLUX.2.
text.uses_the_picture_as_5d9d64c6: Uses the picture as visual guidance; use FLUX Kontext or FLUX.2 for targeted edits.
text.variations_returned_for_each_91722c4a: Variations returned for each input job. Inputs × variations cannot exceed 50 output images per request.
